name: Globe Arch Floor Lamp
desc: A modern arc floor lamp featuring a tall slender stem, sweeping curved arm, dome-shaped metal shade, and a round marble-style base. The sculptural form provides focused downward illumination while adding a contemporary decorative accent to living rooms, lounges, bedrooms, and reading areas.

specifications.Body: Tall slim metal stem with curved arch arm
specifications.Light Distribution: Focused downward illumination with soft ambient spill
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 1850 mm overall height x 450 mm shade diameter
specifications.Recommended Use: Living room / Reading corner / Bedroom / Lounge / Sofa-side lighting
